03

Missions

Love in deeds, not only in words.

We help people going through hard times, then walk with them toward self-reliance. Everything is free.

Three programmes

  1. 1

    Support for people in need

    Food, clothing, financial and spiritual help for people going through difficult situations.

  2. 2

    Training workshops

    Workshops, seminars, talks and awareness campaigns, so that everyone can become self-reliant.

  3. 3

    Helping other associations

    Supporting the projects of other associations that carry social and humanitarian work.

Four areas of aid

  1. 01

    Food

    Food baskets, hot meals during street outreach, and supermarket food drives that fill pantries.

  2. 02

    Clothing

    Coats, boots and clean clothes, sorted by size and season, handed over with dignity.

  3. 03

    Schooling

    School supplies, books and study support for children, orphanages and students.

  4. 04

    Material or financial

    A one-off helping hand when a family goes through a trial: rent, an appliance, a starter kit.

In the field

Food drives

At supermarket entrances we invite shoppers to add one item for a family. Every drive fills baskets that go out the same week.

Street outreach

On the streets of several Canadian cities, meeting the homeless, orphanages and students: a hot meal, a piece of clothing, a prayer, a conversation.

Montréal and several cities across Canada. Countries supported abroad: [to confirm].
